crossRefs.note: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

translations.web: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.
translations.bsb: For I do not do the good I want to do. Instead, I keep on doing the evil I do not want to do.
translations.kjv: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
translations.asv: For the good which I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I practise.
